ground_truth_reason: Reported account balance differs from the sum of its points ledger transactions.
The redemption request exceeds the available points balance. It must be rejected without creating a redemption points debit.
The returned order should reverse the points earned on the returned quantity. The injected faulty behavior reverses zero.
The same account and points lot must not be expired more than once. The duplicate attempt must be idempotently rejected.
Tier qualification must use qualifying spend after discounts and refunds, not gross order value.
